experiences.name: Bo-Kaap
experiences.description: A Cape Town neighbourhood with a long history and a predominantly Muslim Cape Malay community. Its culture is the life of its residents, not just the appearance of its buildings.

experiences.name: Bo-Kaap food experience
experiences.description: Explore Cape Malay cooking through a locally run restaurant or experience, with availability checked and no partnership implied.

visitorNote: Describe a living neighbourhood respectfully. Do not imply that residents, homes or cultural activities are attractions open to visitors.
